description: KMI's own §9 'Open questions' (media-interchange.md ~line 370), each folded ONLY on the next pressure break, never speculatively (ROADMAP.md Phase F6): (1) OTIO schema-version pinning — which OTIO core schema versions a conformant timeline may declare and how strictly §4.1's upgrade/downgrade path binds an unknown-version consumer; (2) profile-vocabulary granularity — how fine constraints get (e.g. H.264 High@L4.1) before path-finding gets brittle; (4) perceptual-hash choice backing media:perceptual_match, recorded like KGP embedding_model so scores are comparable (§9.4, ties to the Loose-wishlist perceptual-hash-provenance thread); (5) additive-metadata survival — id re-attach after a third-party OTIO round-trip drops metadata.koine (§4.2a). PARKED: reactive by design — each note says 'unless a pressure test forces it into the contract'; this file is authored and held until a pressure break. Public-safe: bind roles.

userStories.title: New KMI pressure-test leg exposing the forced question
userStories.description: Before folding any KMI §9 open question, add the scenario leg that FORCES it — koine only folds an open question when a pressure test breaks on it (each §9 note is explicit).
acceptanceCriteria: A scenarios/ pressure-test leg is added (extending scenarios/e2e-media-transform.md or a new focused scenario) that exercises whichever §9 question the break demands — OTIO schema-version pinning (§9.1), profile-vocabulary granularity (§9.2), perceptual-hash backend for media:perceptual_match (§9.4), or metadata.koine id re-attach after a third-party OTIO round-trip (§9.5) — and demonstrates the concrete break that forces a contract answer.
The leg is adversarial (prefer finding a break) and uses the KINP §3.4 placeholder namespaces per scenarios/README.md.
Only the question(s) the break actually forces are carried into US-2 — the others stay open, consistent with the reactive-fold policy.

userStories.title: Fold the forced §9 question(s) into the KMI contract
userStories.description: Reflect only the pressure-forced open question(s) into media-interchange.md (and registry/schema if perceptual-hash provenance is involved), bumping the version and returning to candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: media-interchange.md §4 / §9 is edited to fold the forced question: e.g. pin the allowed OTIO core schema versions (§9.1), fix profile-vocabulary granularity (§9.2), name the pHash/fingerprint/embedding backend and record it like KGP embedding_model (§9.4), or require id re-attach on re-import (§9.5).

If perceptual-hash provenance is folded, the recording field is added minimally (schema twin + registry note if a new immutable relation name is needed — never an in-place signature edit, CLAUDE.md registry rule), keeping media:perceptual_match a similarity signal, never identity.
The KMI version header is bumped and Status set to candidate with a changelog entry citing the scenario leg; the remaining §9 questions stay listed as open.
